title: Determination of the Representative Sample Size in Linear Regression
summary: Very often, accuracy of analysis and forecasting (multiple coefficient of regression and residual means) obtained for a sample used to formulate a regression model is not equal to the accuracy achieved for another homogeneous sample. Indeed, accuracy of analysis and forecasting based on another sample is much worse. This is explained by the discrepancy between a postulated and a real model. This discrepancy is caused by the redundancy of the number of terms of an approximating series. It describes a phenomenon under study with the sample noise. To filter this noise it is necessary to…
